canonical_title: Palo Alto Networks launches Unit 42 Continuous Frontier AI Defense
aliases: Palo Alto frontier AI cybersecurity service
treatment: Covered at launch. Reinclude only for material availability, pricing, measured efficacy, model-mix, exploit-validation, or deployment changes.
known_facts: Palo Alto Networks announced a globally available annual-subscription service that continuously tests web apps, APIs and cloud infrastructure using Claude Mythos 5, GPT-5.6-Cyber and open-weight models.
The service identifies vulnerabilities and attack paths and provides remediation guidance including code-level fixes and virtual patching.
Pricing depends on the selected mix of AI models.
reinclude_only_if: Official pricing or availability details materially change.
Palo Alto Networks publishes reproducible efficacy or exploit-validation results.
The supported frontier-model mix or deployment model changes materially.
notes: Reuters publication 2026-09-22 13:34 UTC, inside the Night Lite window. Distinct from earlier Frontier AI Defense program/model-integration announcements because this is the Continuous service launch and commercial subscription offering.
